title: 40 people told ICIG of reverse engineering program

tellings.quote: you have to be pretty darn weird to go to the ICIG, Inspector General, and say I was part of a I was part of a reverse engineering program. That's that's right. 40 people have done allegedly, right?

plain: Some 40 people have allegedly gone to the Inspector General of the Intelligence Community, the official watchdog that takes complaints from inside US spy agencies, and said they took part in a secret program to reverse-engineer unknown technology, meaning to take it apart and copy it. Michels raises this himself, without naming a source, during a debate with the UFO skeptic Mick West. His point is that you would have to be very strange to make that claim to such an office if it were not true.
